subject: Request: Security evidence bundle + PO instructions for MoxieOps onboarding
messages:
From: procurement@moxieops.com (MoxieOps Procurement)
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com
Cc: lisa.torres@moxieops.com
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security and PO intake for Redwood integration

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked good and the team is ready to move forward. Procurement asked me to collect the following as part of our vendor activation before we can route a PO: 

- Fully executed DPA (or DocuSign-ready envelope)
- Link to your SOC 2 Type II report (or instructions to access the auditor portal)
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Standard W-9 and invoicing remit instructions
- Any regional data residency notes (we are US-only for this contract)

Can you please send the packet (or point us to a single Drive folder) and confirm your preferred PO terms (Net 30, Net 45, etc.) and the invoice email for AP? We aim to issue the PO by end of next week.

Appreciate a single-point bundle so our vendor team can close this quickly.

Regards,
MoxieOps Procurement
[attachment: onboarding-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com
To: procurement@moxieops.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodai.com, jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-04-18T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security and PO intake for Redwood integration

Hi — thanks, and excited to get MoxieOps live. Quick summary of what I’m attaching/including below and next steps: 

1) DPA: We prepared an exec-ready DPA. I’ve uploaded the DocuSign envelope to our shared Drive and also attached a PDF copy for your legal team to review.
- Attachment: redwood-DPA-exec.pdf (application/pdf)
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare?env=prod&doc=redwood-DPA-exec

2) SOC 2 access: We can either share a one-time auditor link or a redacted PDF. For fast review, here’s the drive link to the SOC 2 folder (access set to MoxieOps emails): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-docs-for-moxieops

3) Subprocessors: current inventory exported (CSV) included in Drive and attached.
- Attachment: subprocessor-inventory-2026.csv (text/csv)

4) PO and billing: Our AP prefers Net 30. Invoices should be sent to ap@redwoodai.com with PO number referenced.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Ben (cc’d) will create the internal PO instructions for finance and confirm the bill-to address.
- I can share the DocuSign envelope to lisa.torres@moxieops.com once you confirm the legal contact.

If you need a redacted SOC 2 PDF instead of shared Drive access, tell me and I’ll attach it.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
[signature block]
From: lisa.torres@moxieops.com
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-04-19T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security and PO intake for Redwood integration

Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/finance: 

- Net 30 is fine. Please confirm the legal name for the PO (we require the registered entity).
- We need the SOC 2 PDF (redacted OK) instead of a Drive link for our internal auditors. Can you attach that?
- For the subprocessor list: please confirm whether any subprocessors process EU data (we have a clause for cross-border subprocessors even though this contract is US-only).
- Finally, can you confirm whether Redwood uses any third-party logging vendor (we list that separately in our intake).

Once we have the SOC 2 PDF + registered name, procurement will generate an initial PO and share it for signature.

Thanks — Lisa
Lisa Torres
Procurement Manager, MoxieOps
From: priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com
To: lisa.torres@moxieops.com, procurement@moxieops.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodai.com, jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-04-20T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security and PO intake for Redwood integration

Hi Lisa — good questions, answers below and I've attached a redacted SOC 2 PDF for your audit team. 

- Registered legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — please use this for PO generation.
- SOC 2: attached redwood-SOC2-Redacted-2026.pdf (application/pdf) and also placed in the Drive folder for your records.
- Subprocessors: the attached CSV lists current subprocessors and data processing roles. None of the listed subprocessors process EU customer data for this engagement — everything is US-region only.
- Logging vendor: we use LogStream Inc. for centralized telemetry ingestion; their role is limited to metrics and system logs, not application PII. Entry included in subprocessor CSV.

Attachments: redwood-SOC2-Redacted-2026.pdf, subprocessor-inventory-2026.csv, redwood-DPA-exec.pdf

Ben — can you confirm that AP will accept the PO to ap@redwoodai.com and that Net 30 terms will be honored? Also, can you create the internal PO ticket and route to Finance Ops so procurement can share the PO number back to MoxieOps?

Thanks,
Priya
From: ben.carter@redwoodai.com
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-04-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security and PO intake for Redwood integration

Thanks Priya — confirmed. AP will accept invoices to ap@redwoodai.com and Net 30 is standard. I created PO ticket #PO-2026-3789 and assigned to Finance Ops; ETA for PO issuance is 2 business days once MoxieOps returns the signed DPA.

Action items for Priya: please send the DocuSign envelope directly to lisa.torres@moxieops.com (I will not initiate signing on behalf of Legal). Once signed, forward signed DPA to procurement and I'll mark the PO ticket ready for issuance.

Note: I reviewed the subprocessor inventory and logged LogStream Inc. in our vendor registry. No EU processing flagged.

Ben Carter
Senior Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
[attachment stub: PO-2026-3789-ticket.txt (text/plain)]
